name: pipeline-reviewed
objective: fix bugs and ship features without Owner stepping in

stages.name: capture
stages.purpose: everyone knows what is wrong or wanted

steps.name: write down what is wrong or wanted
steps.instruction: Read the issue and the code it is about. Report what is wrong (for a bug) or wanted (for a feature), and report each point the issue leaves open as an assumption. Set user_visible: does someone reading the report see the change?

stages.name: refine
stages.purpose: the work is understood before it is built

steps.name: find the cause
steps.instruction: Find the line that causes the bug, and say why it is wrong and what it should do.
report: the line, why it is wrong, and what it should do

steps.name: write the spec
steps.instruction: Write docs/spec-<issue number>.md: what changes, an example of input and output, and each choice the issue leaves open with what you chose. Hand in the gate with the spec's main points: Owner approves it.
report: the spec's main points, and the choices it makes

stages.name: build
stages.purpose: the change is made, with tests

steps.name: reproduce the bug with a failing test
steps.instruction: Write a test under test/ that fails because of the bug, and run npm test to show it failing.
report: the failing test, and the npm test run that shows it

steps.name: write the code and its tests
steps.instruction: Make the change, with tests under test/. Run npm test until it is green.

steps.name: document it for users
steps.instruction: Say in README.md what users can now do, or what changed for them.

stages.name: test
stages.purpose: the change is shown to work

steps.name: run the full suite
steps.instruction: Run npm test once more. The workflow's tool capture keeps its totals and any failing test: name the run in your self check.

steps.name: check the spec's examples by hand
steps.instruction: Run each example in the spec with node -e, and compare what it prints with the spec.
report: each example and what it printed

steps.name: show the bug is fixed
steps.instruction: Run the test from step 3.1 again, and show that it passes now.

steps.name: have the change reviewed
steps.instruction: Hand in the gate with the diff of the change and the issue it answers: Drillmaster reviews that the change does what the issue asks, with its test, and nothing else.
report: what changed, and the issue it answers

rules.rule: every change has a test, and npm test is green
rules.verified_by: the npm test totals the tool capture kept

rules.rule: a bug fix starts with a test that fails because of the bug
rules.verified_by: the failing npm test run, before the fix

rules.rule: the spec says what changes, gives an example, and lists the choices the issue leaves open
the change does what the issue asks, with its test, and nothing else
rules.verified_by: reading the diff against the issue

inputs.name: kind
inputs.instruction: Is this work item a bug fix or a feature?

inputs.name: user_visible

options.description: someone reading the report sees the change
nothing a reader of the report sees changes
